BiblicalUsage: Kindynos is danger, peril itself. Romans 8:35 asks whether peril shall separate us from the love of Christ, and 2 Corinthians 11:26 counts Paul's perils one by one: perils of waters, of robbers, of his own countrymen, of the heathen, in the city, in the wilderness, in the sea, among false brethren.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Romans 8:35 is the answer to 2 Corinthians 11:26: Paul survived every peril on the list because none of them could separate him from the love of Christ.
